## Regen Gamerule

---

[Entity Condition Type](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki/Regen-Gamerule)

Returns the value of the `doNaturalRegen` [gamerule](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki/Regen-Gamerule).

Type ID: `proviorigins:can_natural_regen`

## Fields

---

## Examples
```json
"entity_condition": {
    "type": "proviorigins:can_natural_regen"
}
```
